gloss: two households (two generations under one roof)

definitions.gloss: two households; two generations living together
definitions.explanation: Two family units, usually parents and a married child's family, living in the same house. Used mostly in {二世帯住宅|にせたいじゅうたく}, a house built for two generations, often with separate kitchens or entrances.

examples.japanese: {二世帯住宅|にせたいじゅうたく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{建|た}てる→建てる：01189_tateru⟧。
⟦{私|わたし}たち→私たち：28351_watashitachi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{妻|つま}→妻：01005_tsuma⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{両親|りょうしん}→両親：00806_ryoushin⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{二世帯|にせたい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{暮|く}らしている→暮らす：01937_kurasu⟧。
examples.english: We live as two households with my wife's parents.

examples.japanese: {二世帯住宅|にせたいじゅうたく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{玄関|げんかん}→玄関：05003_genkan⟧や⟦{台所|だいどころ}→台所：01021_daidokoro⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{分|わ}ける→分ける：02333_wakeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦お{互|たが}い→お互い：00336_otagai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{気|き}→気：02199_ki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}わ→使う：00473_tsukau⟧ず⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{済|す}む→済む：01950_sumu⟧。
examples.english: In a two-generation house, separate entrances and kitchens save both families from having to tiptoe around each other.

notes:
⟦{二|に}→二：00736_ni⟧ + ⟦{世帯|せたい}→世帯：06870_setai⟧ (household).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {二世帯住宅|にせたいじゅうたく}: two-generation house
- {完全分離型|かんぜんぶんりがた}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{二世帯住宅|にせたいじゅうたく}: a fully separated two-generation house
- {二世帯|にせたい}⟦{同居|どうきょ}→同居：09730_doukyo⟧: two generations living together

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{同居|どうきょ}→同居：09730_doukyo⟧: living together (with family), not necessarily as two households
- {三世代|さんせだい}: three generations (grandparents, parents, children); note ⟦{世代|せだい}→世代：05102_sedai⟧ (generation) vs. ⟦{世帯|せたい}→世帯：06870_setai⟧ (household)
